message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Plan phase complete. Branch: 001-transactions. IMPL_PLAN: /testbed/specs/001-transactions/plan.md (124 lines, written over the template copied by setup_plan.py --json, which returned FEATURE_SPEC/IMPL_PLAN/FEATURE_DIR/BRANCH). Generated artifacts: research.md (137 lines; Phase 0 decisions R1-R7 with alternatives: R1 compose LRUCache via public mapping protocol instead of subclass/reimplement; R2 dual tag indexes key->frozenset + tag->set with single _remove choke point; R3 validate-before-mutate for atomicity; R4 maxsize rule isinstance(int) and not bool and >0; R5 Claim-A open item RESOLVED — adopt put-refreshes-recency on overwrite, satisfied by construction via LRUCache.__setitem__ move_to_end, with explicit risk note for a dedicated test; R6 stdlib copy.deepcopy both directions; R7 tag validation order: bare-str reject -> iterability -> per-element str check -> frozenset dedup); data-model.md (73 lines: Entry/Tag/Capacity entities, storage layout, 6 invariants, state-transition table, validation->error table); contracts/tagged-cache-api.md (82 lines: full public surface TaggedCache(maxsize), put/get/invalidate, len/contains/iter, error contract, explicit non-goals); quickstart.md (85 lines: 4 validation scenarios with exact commands — acceptance_public.py gate, tests/test_tagged.py coverage list, upstream-regression gate via git status/diff + pytest tests/, optional smoke script — and exit criteria). Constitution Check (pre-Phase 0): PASS on all 5 principles of constitution v1.0.0, gate result PASS, no violations; re-evaluated post-Phase 1: still PASS (design stayed minimal/additive). Technical Context filled with observed line-level evidence from src/cachetools/__init__.py (LRUCache lines 203-237: setitem/getitem refresh recency, delitem/popitem clean order; Cache lines 62-105: no maxsize validation, getsizeof default 1) — no NEEDS CLARIFICATION remains. Evidence (observed): wc -l on all 5 artifacts (501 total lines); git status --porcelain shows only untracked .specify/, TASK_STAGE_1.md, acceptance_public.py, specs/ — zero modifications to tracked upstream files (Principle I upheld). No .specify/extensions.yml exists, so no before/after hooks were checked or run. Next: $speckit-tasks to generate tasks.md from these artifacts, then implement src/cachetools/tagged.py + tests/test_tagged.py per quickstart.md exit criteria."}
